function.name: gdi_dc_acquire
function.description: This function acquires a device context (DC) for a given graphics object. If the graphics object already has a DC, it increments the reference count and returns the existing DC. If the graphics object owns its own DC, it gets a DC for the associated window and returns that. If neither of these conditions are met, it returns an error.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: A pointer to the graphics object for which the DC is to be acquired.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: A pointer to a variable that receives the handle to the device context.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. It can return 'Ok' if the operation is successful, 'OutOfMemory' if it fails to get a DC for the associated window, and 'InvalidParameter' if neither of the conditions are met.

function.name: gdi_dc_release
function.description: This function releases a device context (DC) from a GpGraphics object. It decreases the reference count of the DC, and if the GpGraphics object owns the DC and the reference count reaches zero, it sets the DC to NULL and releases it.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: A pointer to the GpGraphics object that holds the device context.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: The device context to be released.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: convert_path_point_type
function.description: This function converts a given path point type to its corresponding byte value. It also checks if the path point type is a subpath and if so, it modifies the return value accordingly.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: This parameter represents the type of the path point that needs to be converted.

function.return_type: BYTE, represents the converted value of the path point type.

function.name: get_gdi_brush_color
function.description: This function retrieves the color of a GDI brush object, handling different types of brushes including solid color, hatch fill, linear gradient, and path gradient. If the brush type is not handled, it returns a default color.

parameters.name: brush
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the GDI brush object from which the color is to be retrieved.

function.return_type: COLORREF, which represents the color of the brush in ARGB format.

function.name: is_metafile_graphics
function.description: This function checks if the image in the graphics object is a metafile image.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a GpGraphics object that contains the image to be checked.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the image is a metafile image, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: init_hatch_palette
function.description: This function initializes a hatch palette by assigning colors to it. It uses a blend of foreground and background colors.

parameters.name: hatch_palette
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the hatch palette that will be initialized

parameters.name: fore_color
parameters.description: This is the foreground color that will be used in the blend

parameters.name: back_color
parameters.description: This is the background color that will be used in the blend

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return anything

function.name: create_hatch_bitmap
function.description: This function creates a hatch bitmap. It initializes a bitmap, gets hatch data based on the hatch style, initializes a hatch palette, and then fills the bitmap with the hatch pattern. If the hatch style is not implemented, it fills the bitmap with the foreground color.

parameters.name: hatch
parameters.description: Pointer to a GpHatch structure that contains information about the hatch

parameters.name: origin_x
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the origin of the hatch pattern

parameters.name: origin_y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the origin of the hatch pattern

function.return_type: HBITMAP, which represents the handle to the bitmap that is created by the function

function.name: create_gdi_logbrush
function.description: This function creates a GDI logical brush by setting the properties of a LOGBRUSH structure based on the type of the GpBrush passed to it.

parameters.name: brush
parameters.description: Pointer to the GpBrush structure that defines the brush to be created.

parameters.name: lb
parameters.description: Pointer to the LOGBRUSH structure that receives the properties of the created brush.

parameters.name: origin_x
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the point at which to start the hatch.

parameters.name: origin_y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the point at which to start the hatch.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if the operation is successful, 'OutOfMemory' if the operation fails due to insufficient memory.

function.name: free_gdi_logbrush
function.description: This function deletes an object if the style of the LOGBRUSH pointed to by lb is BS_PATTERN.

parameters.name: lb
parameters.description: Pointer to a LOGBRUSH structure

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation, returns Ok if successful

function.name: create_gdi_brush
function.description: This function creates a GDI brush using the given brush, origin x and y coordinates. It first creates a logical brush, then creates a GDI brush using this logical brush, and finally frees the logical brush.

parameters.name: brush
parameters.description: Pointer to the brush to be used for creating the GDI brush

parameters.name: origin_x
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the brush's origin

parameters.name: origin_y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the brush's origin

function.return_type: HBRUSH, represents the created GDI brush. If the creation of the logical brush fails, it returns 0.

function.name: prepare_dc
function.description: This function prepares a device context for drawing by setting up the pen and other graphical parameters.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: Pointer to a GpGraphics object that contains graphical settings.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: pen
parameters.description: Pointer to a GpPen object that defines the pen to be used for drawing.

function.return_type: INT, represents the saved state of the device context before it was modified by the function.

function.name: restore_dc
function.description: This function deletes an object selected into the specified device context and then restores the device context to a specified state.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: Pointer to the GpGraphics object

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The saved state to be restored

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value

function.name: round_points
function.description: This function rounds the points of a given array and assigns the rounded values to another array. If the value is not a number (NaN), it assigns zero to the corresponding element in the target array.

parameters.name: pti
parameters.description: This is the target array where the rounded values will be stored.

parameters.name: ptf
parameters.description: This is the source array from where the values will be taken and rounded.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: This represents the number of elements in the arrays.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value but modifies the 'pti' array in place.

function.name: gdi_alpha_blend
function.description: This function performs alpha blending, which involves combining a source color with a destination color to create the appearance of partial or full transparency.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: Pointer to the graphics object

parameters.name: dst_x
parameters.description: X-coordinate of the destination upper-left corner

parameters.name: dst_y
parameters.description: Y-coordinate of the destination upper-left corner

parameters.name: dst_width
parameters.description: Width of the destination rectangle

parameters.name: dst_height
parameters.description: Height of the destination rectangle

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the source device context

parameters.name: src_x
parameters.description: X-coordinate of the source upper-left corner

parameters.name: src_y
parameters.description: Y-coordinate of the source upper-left corner

parameters.name: src_width
parameters.description: Width of the source rectangle

parameters.name: src_height
parameters.description: Height of the source rectangle

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: get_graphics_device_bounds
function.description: This function retrieves the bounds of a graphics device. Depending on the type of the graphics device (window, image, memory device context, or other), it uses different methods to determine the bounds.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: Pointer to a GpGraphics object representing the graphics device whose bounds are to be retrieved.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: Pointer to a GpRectF object where the function will store the bounds of the graphics device.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if the operation is successful, 'GenericError' if there is an error in retrieving the bounds of a window, or the status of the operation of retrieving the bounds of an image.

function.name: get_clip_hrgn
function.description: This function gets the clipping region of a graphics object, transforms it if necessary, and stores it in a HRGN object.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: A pointer to the graphics object from which the clipping region is to be obtained.

parameters.name: hrgn
parameters.description: A pointer to a HRGN object where the clipping region will be stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. If the function executes successfully, it returns 'Ok'. Otherwise, it returns an error status.

function.name: alpha_blend_bmp_pixels
function.description: This function blends source bitmap pixels into a destination bitmap using alpha blending. The blending mode can be either source copy or alpha blending, depending on the compositing mode of the graphics object.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: Pointer to the graphics object that contains the destination bitmap and compositing mode

parameters.name: dst_x
parameters.description: The x-coordinate in the destination bitmap where the source bitmap starts

parameters.name: dst_y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate in the destination bitmap where the source bitmap starts

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Pointer to the source bitmap pixels

parameters.name: src_width
parameters.description: The width of the source bitmap

parameters.name: src_height
parameters.description: The height of the source bitmap

parameters.name: src_stride
parameters.description: The byte count from one row of the source bitmap to the next

parameters.name: fmt
parameters.description: The pixel format of the source bitmap

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation, returns 'Ok' if the operation is successful

function.name: blend_32bppARGB
function.description: This function blends a source image into a destination image using alpha blending. The images are assumed to be in 32bpp ARGB format.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The width of the images in pixels.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The height of the images in pixels.

parameters.name: dst_bits
parameters.description: A pointer to the destination image data.

parameters.name: dst_stride
parameters.description: The number of bytes in a row of the destination image.

parameters.name: src_bits
parameters.description: A pointer to the source image data.

parameters.name: src_stride
parameters.description: The number of bytes in a row of the source image.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value but modifies the destination image in place.

function.name: alpha_blend_hdc_pixels
function.description: This function blends source and destination pixels using alpha blending. It creates a compatible device context, a bitmap, and then performs the blending operation based on the pixel format. The result is then selected into the device context and the original bitmap is deleted.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: Pointer to the graphics object where the blending operation is performed.

parameters.name: dst_x
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the destination upper-left corner.

parameters.name: dst_y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the destination upper-left corner.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Pointer to the source pixels to be blended.

parameters.name: src_width
parameters.description: The width of the source pixels.

parameters.name: src_height
parameters.description: The height of the source pixels.

parameters.name: src_stride
parameters.description: The stride, or pitch, of the source bitmap.

parameters.name: fmt
parameters.description: The pixel format of the source bitmap.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if the operation is successful.

function.name: alpha_blend_pixels_hrgn
function.description: This function blends pixels in a specified region using alpha blending. It handles both bitmap and metafile images.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: Pointer to the graphics object where the blending will be applied.

parameters.name: dst_x
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the destination upper-left corner.

parameters.name: dst_y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the destination upper-left corner.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Pointer to the source buffer to blend.

parameters.name: src_width
parameters.description: The width of the source buffer.

parameters.name: src_height
parameters.description: The height of the source buffer.

parameters.name: src_stride
parameters.description: The stride, or pitch, of the source buffer.

parameters.name: hregion
parameters.description: Handle to the region where the blending will be applied.

parameters.name: fmt
parameters.description: The pixel format used for blending.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. It can be 'Ok' for successful operations, 'OutOfMemory' if there is not enough memory to complete the operation, 'NotImplemented' if the operation is not supported for metafiles, or other GpStatus values indicating error conditions.

function.name: alpha_blend_pixels
function.description: This function blends pixels with alpha channel in a given graphics context.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: Pointer to the graphics context where the blending operation is performed.

parameters.name: dst_x
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the destination point in the graphics context.

parameters.name: dst_y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the destination point in the graphics context.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Pointer to the source pixel data to be blended.

parameters.name: src_width
parameters.description: The width of the source pixel data.

parameters.name: src_height
parameters.description: The height of the source pixel data.

parameters.name: src_stride
parameters.description: The stride, or pitch, of the source pixel data.

parameters.name: fmt
parameters.description: The pixel format of the source data.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns Ok. Otherwise, it returns an error code.

function.name: blend_colors
function.description: This function blends two colors based on a given position and returns the resulting color.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The starting color in ARGB format.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: The ending color in ARGB format.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: The position at which to blend the colors, represented as a real number.

function.return_type: ARGB, representing the resulting blended color.

function.name: blend_line_gradient
function.description: This function blends the line gradient based on the position and the brush properties. It handles different wrap modes and blend counts, and interpolates between blend positions and colors.

parameters.name: brush
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the GpLineGradient object which contains the gradient properties such as blend positions, blend factors, blend colors, start and end colors, wrap mode, and rectangle dimensions.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: This is the position at which the gradient needs to be blended. It is used to calculate the blend factor and to interpolate between blend positions and colors.

function.return_type: ARGB. It represents the color in ARGB format obtained after blending the gradient at the specified position.

function.name: round_color_matrix
function.description: Converts floating point color matrix to int[5][5], returns TRUE if it's an identity

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: Pointer to the color matrix to be converted

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: Array to store the converted values

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the color matrix is an identity matrix, FALSE otherwise

function.name: transform_color
function.description: This function transforms a color using a matrix. It first extracts the red, green, blue, and alpha components from the input color. Then, it multiplies each component by the corresponding row in the matrix, and sums the results. The output color is then constructed from these transformed components.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: The input color to be transformed.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: The transformation matrix. Each row corresponds to a color component (red, green, blue, alpha, translation).

function.return_type: ARGB, representing the transformed color.

function.name: color_is_gray
function.description: This function checks if a given ARGB color is a shade of gray. A color is considered gray if the red, green, and blue components are equal.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: This parameter represents the ARGB color to be checked.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the color is a shade of gray, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: apply_image_attributes
function.description: This function applies various image attributes such as color keys, color remap tables, color matrices, and gamma correction to an image.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Pointer to the image attributes to be applied

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the image data

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Width of the image

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Height of the image

parameters.name: stride
parameters.description: Stride of the image (distance in bytes between the starts of two consecutive lines)

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Type of color adjustment to be applied

parameters.name: fmt
parameters.description: Format of the pixels in the image

function.return_type: PixelFormat, represents the format of the pixels in the image after applying the attributes

function.name: get_bitmap_sample_size
function.description: This function calculates the sample size for a bitmap based on the provided parameters. It uses different interpolation and wrap modes to determine the boundaries of the sample size. The results are stored in a GpRect structure.

parameters.name: interpolation
parameters.description: The interpolation mode to be used for calculating the sample size.

parameters.name: wrap
parameters.description: The wrap mode to be used for calculating the sample size.

parameters.name: bitmap
parameters.description: The bitmap for which the sample size is to be calculated.

parameters.name: srcx
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the source rectangle.

parameters.name: srcy
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the source rectangle.

parameters.name: srcwidth
parameters.description: The width of the source rectangle.

parameters.name: srcheight
parameters.description: The height of the source rectangle.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: The structure in which the calculated sample size will be stored.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value but modifies the 'rect' parameter to store the calculated sample size.

function.name: sample_bitmap_pixel
function.description: This function samples a pixel from a bitmap, taking into account the wrap mode and other attributes. It also handles out of range pixels.

parameters.name: src_rect
parameters.description: The source rectangle from which to sample the pixel.

parameters.name: bits
parameters.description: The bitmap data.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The width of the bitmap.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The height of the bitmap.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the pixel to sample.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the pixel to sample.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: The attributes of the image, including wrap mode and outside color.

function.return_type: ARGB, which represents the color of the sampled pixel.

function.name: resample_bitmap_pixel
function.description: This function resamples a bitmap pixel using a specified interpolation and pixel offset mode.

parameters.name: src_rect
parameters.description: Pointer to the source rectangle.

parameters.name: bits
parameters.description: Pointer to the bitmap bits.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Width of the bitmap.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Height of the bitmap.

parameters.name: point
parameters.description: Pointer to the point in the bitmap to resample.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Pointer to the image attributes.

parameters.name: interpolation
parameters.description: The interpolation mode to use for resampling.

parameters.name: offset_mode
parameters.description: The pixel offset mode to use for resampling.

function.return_type: ARGB, which represents the resampled pixel color.

function.name: intersect_line_scanline
function.description: This function calculates the intersection of a line defined by two points and a horizontal scanline at a given y-coordinate.

parameters.name: p1
parameters.description: Pointer to the first point defining the line

parameters.name: p2
parameters.description: Pointer to the second point defining the line

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the scanline

function.return_type: REAL, represents the x-coordinate of the intersection point

function.name: brush_can_fill_path
function.description: This function checks if a brush can fill a path based on the brush type and fill status.

parameters.name: brush
parameters.description: This is the brush that is checked for its ability to fill a path.

parameters.name: is_fill
parameters.description: This parameter indicates if the path is to be filled or not.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the brush can fill the path, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: brush_fill_path
function.description: This function fills a path in a graphics context with a specified brush. It handles different brush types and manages the device context for drawing.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: Pointer to the graphics context where the path will be filled.

parameters.name: brush
parameters.description: Pointer to the brush used to fill the path.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. It can be 'Ok' for successful completion, 'GenericError' for an unspecified failure, or 'OutOfMemory' if the system runs out of resources while executing the function.

function.name: brush_can_fill_pixels
function.description: This function checks if the brush type can fill pixels and returns a boolean value accordingly.

parameters.name: brush
parameters.description: This parameter is used to specify the brush type.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the brush type can fill pixels, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: brush_fill_pixels
function.description: This function fills pixels in a specified area with a brush. The brush can be of different types like solid color, hatch fill, linear gradient, texture fill, or path gradient. The function handles each type differently.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: Pointer to the graphics object where the pixels will be filled.

parameters.name: brush
parameters.description: Pointer to the brush object used to fill the pixels.

parameters.name: argb_pixels
parameters.description: Pointer to the array of pixels to be filled.

parameters.name: fill_area
parameters.description: Pointer to the rectangle object specifying the area to be filled.

parameters.name: cdwStride
parameters.description: Stride width. It is the byte offset between the beginning of one line of pixels in the bitmap and the beginning of the next line.

function.return_type: GpStatus. It represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns 'Ok'. If the brush type is not implemented, it returns 'NotImplemented'. For other errors, it returns appropriate error status.

function.name: draw_cap
function.description: This function is used to draw different types of line caps (endings) based on the provided parameters. It supports various cap styles including flat, square, diamond, arrow, round, triangle, and custom.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: Pointer to the graphics context where the cap will be drawn.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Color of the line cap.

parameters.name: cap
parameters.description: Type of the line cap to be drawn.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of the line cap.

parameters.name: custom
parameters.description: Pointer to a custom line cap structure, used when the cap type is custom.

parameters.name: x1
parameters.description: X-coordinate of the first point of the line.

parameters.name: y1
parameters.description: Y-coordinate of the first point of the line.

parameters.name: x2
parameters.description: X-coordinate of the second point of the line.

parameters.name: y2
parameters.description: Y-coordinate of the second point of the line.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value but performs the drawing operation based on the provided parameters.

function.name: shorten_line_percent
function.description: This function shortens a line by a given percentage. The line is defined by two points (x1, y1) and (x2, y2). The function modifies the second point (x2, y2) to shorten the line.

parameters.name: x1
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the first point of the line.

parameters.name: y1
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the first point of the line.

parameters.name: x2
parameters.description: A pointer to the x-coordinate of the second point of the line. This value is modified by the function.

parameters.name: y2
parameters.description: A pointer to the y-coordinate of the second point of the line. This value is modified by the function.

parameters.name: percent
parameters.description: The percentage by which to shorten the line.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return a value but modifies the input parameters.

function.name: shorten_line_amt
function.description: This function shortens a line by a given amount. It calculates the new end point of the line after shortening.

parameters.name: x1
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the start point of the line.

parameters.name: y1
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the start point of the line.

parameters.name: x2
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the end point of the line. This value is updated by the function.

parameters.name: y2
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the end point of the line. This value is updated by the function.

parameters.name: amt
parameters.description: The amount by which to shorten the line.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value but modifies the x2 and y2 parameters to reflect the new end point of the line after shortening.

function.name: shorten_bezier_amt
function.description: This function shortens a Bezier curve by a specified amount. It modifies the original points of the curve in order to achieve the shortening effect. The order of the points is reversed if the 'rev' parameter is true.

parameters.name: pt
parameters.description: This is a pointer to an array of four points that define the Bezier curve.

parameters.name: amt
parameters.description: This is the amount by which to shorten the Bezier curve.

parameters.name: rev
parameters.description: This boolean value determines whether the order of the points should be reversed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value but modifies the input array of points.

function.name: draw_poly
function.description: This function draws a polygon on a graphics object using a specified pen, points, types, count, and caps. It also handles memory allocation and error checking for the drawing process.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: Pointer to the graphics object where the polygon will be drawn

parameters.name: pen
parameters.description: Pointer to the pen object that defines the color, width, and style of the polygon

parameters.name: pt
parameters.description: Pointer to the points that define the vertices of the polygon

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Pointer to the types that define the type of each point in the polygon

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of points in the polygon

parameters.name: caps
parameters.description: Boolean value that determines whether caps are drawn at the ends of lines

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the drawing operation. It can be Ok, GenericError, or OutOfMemory depending on the success or failure of the operation

function.name: trace_path
function.description: This function traces a path on a graphics object using the specified path data. It acquires a device context, begins a path, draws a polygon, ends the path and releases the device context.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the graphics object where the path will be traced.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the path object that contains the data for the path to be traced.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns 'Ok'. If not, it returns the error status.

function.name: init_container
function.description: This function initializes a graphics container with given graphics and type. It also clones the region of the graphics to the container. If the cloning is unsuccessful, it frees the allocated memory and returns the status.

parameters.name: container
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to a GraphicsContainerItem structure. This is where the initialized container will be stored.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: A pointer to a GpGraphics structure. This provides the graphics details to be initialized in the container.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of the graphics container to be initialized.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the function execution. Returns 'Ok' if the function executes successfully, 'OutOfMemory' if memory allocation fails, and other status codes if the region cloning fails.

function.name: delete_container
function.description: This function deletes a graphics container item by first deleting the region associated with the container and then freeing the memory allocated to the container.

parameters.name: container
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the graphics container item that is to be deleted.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: restore_container
function.description: This function restores the state of a graphics container by cloning the region, updating the world transformation, deleting the old region, and updating various graphics properties.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: Pointer to the graphics object to be updated

parameters.name: container
parameters.description: Pointer to the container from which the state is to be restored

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation, returns 'Ok' if the operation is successful

function.name: get_graphics_bounds
function.description: This function gets the bounds of a graphics object and modifies the rectangle object to fit the bounds. It also checks if the graphics object has a GDI device context and transforms the points accordingly.

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the graphics object whose bounds are to be obtained.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the rectangle object that will be modified to fit the bounds of the graphics object.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns 'Ok'.

function.name: get_visible_clip_region
function.description: This function gets the visible clip region of a graphic. It ignores the graphic image bounds for metafiles, gets the graphic bounds, creates a region, combines the region with the rectangle, combines the region with the graphic's clip, and finally combines the region with the temporary region.

parameters.name: graphics

parameters.name: graphics

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: This is the interpolation mode to be set for the graphics object.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. It can return 'InvalidParameter' if the parameters are not valid, 'ObjectBusy' if the graphics object is busy, or 'Ok' if the operation is successful.
